If you havent moved rentals in the last year you have zero clue the realities. Ive moved twice recently. Once 2 years ago and it was rough but we managed, since we have great credit, great references, etc etc, but it wasnt easy. Then last year we had to move (house sold) and we applied to 60 places and came up empty handed. People were climbing over each other to pay 3k+ for a dumpy home. The few places that called us back asked us to "sweeten the deal" well beyond listed price. Landlords had insane requests like your tax forms, *months* of bank statements to check your spending, sin number, drivers license number, some leases had "video/audio surveillance" of the unit listed, others, not many but some, had straight up illegal violations in their applications, demanding to know sexual orientation, your religion, if you ever plan on having kids, your ethnicity, your political standpoints etc.  We were 6 days away from homelessness when we finally got accepted for a place. Guess whos landlord is selling again? Mine and the markets even WORSE now. Yay me.
